name: 품앗이 에이전트
summary: Free AI models, working as a team
description: A macOS and Windows app that puts several free models on the same question and lets them vote. On the same exams it outscored ChatGPT's free tier. With Pumasi, other users can take a task off your hands with their own free keys, sealed so no one in between can read it.
features: Pumasi: others run your tasks on their free keys
Beat ChatGPT free on three program-graded exams
Skill-weighted vote that closes once it is decided
Switches free providers when one hits its limit
Premium lead model plans; free models do the work
Keys locked in the OS keychain, never shown again

evidence.note: Measurements in bench/README.md: AIME 2026 free bundle 28/30 vs ChatGPT free 24/30; LiveBench logic 23.4 vs 13.4 (official grader); fresh reasoning exam 29 vs 23. Pumasi and the Pumasi Agent name ship in v0.1.10.
